test_title: PYST 07: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In March 2025, NITI Aayog released the 'Future Front: Quarterly Frontier Tech Insights' report. What is the primary focus of this report?

options.text: Reviewing the performance of state-run healthcare programs
Analysing the impact of climate change on coastal regions
Evaluating advancements and investments in quantum computing technologies

solution:
The correct answer is __**Evaluating advancements and investments in quantum computing technologies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Future Front: Quarterly Frontier Tech Insights' report by** NITI Aayog** primarily focuses on advancements in **quantum computing technologies**.
 
• Quantum computing leverages principles of quantum mechanics to perform computations far beyond traditional computing capabilities.
 
• The report aims to **evaluate investments, technological progress, and applications** in quantum computing within India and globally.
 
• India has been actively working on quantum technologies through initiatives such as the **National Quantum Mission**, launched in 2023.
 
• Quantum computing is expected to revolutionize sectors such as cryptography, material science, artificial intelligence, and drug discovery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quantum Computing:**

 
 
• Quantum computing uses quantum bits (qubits) instead of classical bits for processing information.
 
• Qubits can exist in multiple states simultaneously due to the principle of **superposition**.
 
• Quantum entanglement enables qubits to be interconnected, allowing faster and more complex computations.
 
 
 
• **National Quantum Mission:**
 
 
• India launched the National Quantum Mission in 2023 to accelerate quantum research and development.
 
• The mission aims to develop 50-qubit quantum computers and advanced quantum communication systems by 2030.
 
• It also focuses on skill development and collaboration with global institutions.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Quantum Computing:**
 
 
• Quantum computing has potential applications in **cryptography**, enhancing data security.
 
• It aids in solving complex problems in fields like **drug discovery** and **material science**.
 
• It is also being explored for applications in **machine learning** and artificial intelligence.
 
 
 
• **Global Efforts in Quantum Computing:**
 
 
• Countries like the US, China, and the EU have invested heavily in quantum research.
 
• Leading companies like IBM, Google, and Microsoft are developing cutting-edge quantum computing systems.
 
• International collaboration is key to advancing quantum technologies globally.
